content:
In recent backend code changes related to the support for the "Car Key" feature in vehicles under GWM's Tank brand, Apple appears to be preparing to extend this functionality to another brand under the same automaker. Here are the details.

According to reports, the "Car Key" feature in Apple Wallet will soon support Haval vehicles

A few weeks ago, Apple added related code in the backend, showing that vehicles under GWM's Tank brand will soon support the "Car Key" feature in Apple Wallet, allowing users to lock, unlock, and start compatible car models via iPhone or Apple Watch.

Now, as discovered by Aaron Perris on the X platform, Haval—another brand under the same Chinese automaker—has also seen similar code references:

Although several models under GWM's Haval already offer CarPlay, none currently support Apple's standalone "Car Key" feature.

Once the new feature is launched, compatible Haval models will join the current lineup of over 50 models that support the "Car Key" feature, including vehicles from brands such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Kia, Genesis, Toyota, and Rivian.

To learn more about the Apple Wallet "Car Key" feature and view the full list of compatible car models, please follow this link.
